paper.title_en: High precision timing of seven binary millisecond pulsars with the European Pulsar Timing Array
paper.abstract_en: Binary millisecond pulsars (MSPs) serve as exceptional astrophysical laboratories for a wide range of astrophysical studies, all of which rely on precise property measurements allowed by pulsar timing. In this paper, we present high-precision timing solutions for seven binary MSPs monitored by the European Pulsar Timing Array. By combining data collected from the five largest radio telescopes in Europe, as well as their coherently combined form, the Large European Array for Pulsars, we achieve phase-coherent timing solutions for all seven pulsars. We conduct a Bayesian timing and noise analysis on the combined data, yielding measurements of astrometric and orbital parameters with broadly improved precision, some reported for the first time. For PSRs J0125-2327, J1741+1351 and J2043+1711, we determine their distances and transverse velocities from astrometric measurements, and infer their masses via Shapiro delay measurements. Additionally, we examine the various contributions to the secular orbital-period variations for PSRs J0125-2327, J1125+7819 and J1741+1351, and estimate their kinematic distances. For PSRs J0125-2327 and J1741+1351, we detect the signature of annual-orbital parallax in the timing data. This allows us to derive a strongly favored, unique solution for the orbital ascending node and inclination angle for PSR J0125-2327, and a tightly constrained ascending node for PSR J1741+1351. Moreover, we use the orbital periods and their derivatives for several binary MSPs to place upper limits on gravitational-wave strain in both the sub-nanohertz and microhertz frequency regimes. Our results show that the orbits of binary MSPs could provide stringent constraints in microhertz range, thereby possibly complementing standard pulsar-timing-array analyses in the future.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文基于欧洲脉冲星计时阵列（EPTA）五大射电望远镜及LEAP相干合成数据，对七颗双星毫秒脉冲星给出高精度计时解，并进行贝叶斯计时与噪声分析，改进了天体测量与轨道参数精度；还利用轨道周期及其导数在亚纳赫兹与微赫兹频段给出引力波应变上限，并探测到年度-轨道视差信号。内容属于脉冲星计时阵列方向的核心观测与数据分析工作，方法清晰、结果具体，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 利用欧洲脉冲星计时阵列对七颗双星毫秒脉冲星的高精度计时
decision.abstract_zh: 双星毫秒脉冲星（MSP）作为卓越的天体物理实验室，可用于广泛的天体物理研究，而所有这些研究都依赖于脉冲星计时所能实现的精确属性测量。本文给出欧洲脉冲星计时阵列监测的七颗双星MSP的高精度计时解。通过联合欧洲五台最大射电望远镜采集的数据及其相干合成形式——大型欧洲脉冲星阵列（Large European Array for Pulsars），我们为全部七颗脉冲星获得了相位相干的计时解。我们对联合数据进行了贝叶斯计时与噪声分析，得到了精度普遍改善的天体测量与轨道参数测量结果，其中部分参数为首次报告。对于PSR J0125-2327、J1741+1351和J2043+1711，我们由天体测量测量确定了它们的距离和横向速度，并通过Shapiro延迟测量推断了它们的质量。此外，我们考察了PSR J0125-2327、J1125+7819和J1741+1351的长期轨道周期变化的各项贡献，并估算了它们的运动学距离。对于PSR J0125-2327和J1741+1351，我们在计时数据中探测到年度-轨道视差的特征。这使我们能够为PSR J0125-2327得到强烈偏好且唯一的轨道升交点与倾角解，并为PSR J1741+1351得到严格约束的升交点。此外，我们利用若干双星MSP的轨道周期及其导数，在亚纳赫兹和微赫兹频率范围内给出引力波应变的上限。我们的结果表明，双星MSP的轨道可在微赫兹范围内提供严格约束，从而可能在未来补充标准的脉冲星计时阵列分析。
